crossRefs.note: You are arrogant, and didn’t mourn instead, that he who had done this deed might be removed from among you.
Therefore let no one boast in men. For all things are yours,
Now some are puffed up, as though I were not coming to you.
But I will come to you shortly, if the Lord is willing. And I will know, not the word of those who are puffed up, but…
But now you glory in your boasting. All such boasting is evil.
Don’t be deceived! “Evil companionships corrupt good morals.”
He spoke another parable to them. “The Kingdom of Heaven is like yeast, which a woman took, and hid in three measures…
Jesus said to them, “Take heed and beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”
It is like yeast, which a woman took and hid in three measures of flour, until it was all leavened.”
A little yeast grows through the whole lump.
and those words will consume like gangrene, of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus:

parallels.note: A little yeast grows through the whole lump.

translations.web: Your boasting is not good. Don’t you know that a little yeast leavens the whole lump?
translations.bsb: Your boasting is not good. Do you not know that a little leaven works through the whole batch of dough?
translations.kjv: Your glorying is not good. Know ye not that a little leaven leaveneth the whole lump?
translations.asv: Your glorying is not good. Know ye not that a little leaven leaveneth the whole lump?
